description: Purpose: search the cross-domain benchmark layer - the same verifiable-anchor methodology we apply to rCB, extended to other domains (carbon footprint & markets / telecom & space / health & nutrition). Records are policy milestones, official limit values, standards status and dated price snapshots, each with an issuer, an as-of date, a confidence grade and a source_url. Guidelines: filter by domain (carbon / telecom / health), region, category or confidence; every record is meant to be citable - pair with get_domain_benchmark by ID for the full record including the source link. Limits: anchor facts only - no price forecasts (carbon prices are dated snapshots, not live quotes), no medical or dosing advice, no diagnosis; the domain taxonomy is ours, not the issuing body's. Ex: query_domain_benchmarks(domain='carbon'), query_domain_benchmarks(keyword='CBAM'), query_domain_benchmarks(domain='health', confidence='A', language='en').

category.description: 类别过滤，如 '时间节点'、'碳价快照'、'核算标准'、'膳食摄入限值'

confidence.description: 置信度：A=官方一手来源核实, B=权威二手来源, C=待核实

domain.description: 领域过滤：carbon=碳足迹·碳市场 / telecom=通信·空间 / health=健康·营养（可留空取全部）

keyword.description: 关键词模糊匹配，如 'CBAM'、'3GPP'、'游离糖'、'碳市场'

limit.description: 返回条数上限（默认 20，最大 100）

region.description: 地区/组织过滤，如 '国际'、'欧盟'、'中国'

response_format.description: 输出格式：markdown=人类阅读, json=Agent 处理友好

verified.description: true=只看 A 级已核实条目

name: query_domain_benchmarks

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
